definitions.unit: unique review, not a vehicle or owner; topic statistics count each review once per topic
definitions.shares: fractions from 0 to 1; model/country/engine_type maps use all reviews of this topic as denominator
definitions.sentiment: inherited from stage 1; AI does not reclassify reviews or change counts
definitions.neutral: explicit neutral only; undetermined is never silently converted to neutral
definitions.global_sentiment: each original review counted once; combine all its fragments, including fragments without a topic
definitions.negative_rate: negative reviews / reviews in this segment and topic
definitions.negative_or_mixed_rate: (negative + mixed reviews) / reviews in this segment and topic
definitions.share_of_all_topic_negative_reviews: negative reviews in this segment / negative reviews in the entire topic
definitions.topic_prevalence_in_source_segment: reviews in this topic and segment / all original reviews in this segment
definitions.country_engine_type: joint counts, not products of independent marginal shares
definitions.signals: descriptive comparisons, not causal findings or multiple-testing-adjusted significance results

overview.summary: Across the G60 corpus, reviewers most often praise driving enjoyment, ride comfort, quietness, handling, interior and exterior design, build quality, and overall satisfaction, while the clearest recurring pain points concern screen-heavy climate and control usability, missing physical buttons, awkward door handles and access behaviors, inconsistent hands-free trunk and wireless charging performance, connectivity and software friction, and a smaller set of charging, range, and service-resolution frustrations.

signals.statement: In country=GB, 17 of 36 reviews (47.2%) are negative or mixed. The rest of this breakdown: 874 of 3964 (22.0%).
signals.interpretation: GB reviews show a greater concentration of negative-or-mixed feedback than the rest of the country breakdown, and the topic summaries suggest this may align with complaints about controls, usability, and feature friction rather than one single issue.

signals.statement: In country=DK, 9 of 20 reviews (45.0%) are negative or mixed. The rest of this breakdown: 882 of 3980 (22.2%).
signals.interpretation: DK reviews also show a greater concentration of negative-or-mixed feedback than the rest of the country breakdown, which is consistent with the corpus containing several usability, control-layout, and feature-operation complaints that can surface in smaller country slices.

limitations: A large share of the corpus is undetermined, so many fragments are too incomplete, procedural, or context-only to support strong product conclusions.
Topics overlap, so the same review themes can appear in multiple clusters and should not be read as additive counts.
Several clusters mix unrelated subjects or noisy keyword matches, especially service-note, acknowledgment, and procedural topics, which limits thematic precision.
Some topic samples include evidence whose wording is sparse or appears weakly aligned with the assigned sentiment, so those topic-level details should be treated cautiously.
Country signals are exploratory associations only and do not establish cause or broader market-level differences.

warnings: Topic and sentiment errors from the first stage carry through to this report.
AI summaries describe selected examples; counts always use all source review assignments.
Country associations may reflect sample composition or labelling errors; they do not establish vehicle defect rates.
Small segment counts are retained, but automated signals require the configured minimum sample size.
